head: 7a2c8b9
summary: 8.6, the same as confirm3. There is no high or medium issue. No PY code changed, and I verified that every PY seat pixel is the same as at e67f1a9. The q13 and q14 diffs (>2 levels) are confined to y <= 200 and y <= 326. The changed pixels are bins, ceiling, rear wall, curtains and the window glass (q14 changed-pixel mean RGB 226/230/237), not fabric or shell. In q14 the headrest box x 30-200 has 0 % changed, and in q13 the right headrest box has 0 % changed. The seat-back boxes are identical: q13 RGB 95.4/105.9/131.9 (B/R 1.383) and q14 109.8/120.6/142.8 (B/R 1.301). The cooler environment does not make the seats read worse; it helps a little. The q13 rear wall is now B-R +10.6 against +9.3 on the py_37302 wall, where before it was +4.1 and too warm. The fabric/wall luminance ratio is 0.61 (was 0.55); the photo is 0.57. So the navy-grey fabric now sits against a neutral-cool white, as in the photo, rather than a creamy one. The confirm3 lows all carry over unchanged. The main ones are the dark welt crease in the q13 centre-seat valley, triplanar smear on the valley walls, the band being darker than the photo crease, the fabric about 20-35 L darker than the photo, and the thin-dark proxy at 59 %.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) The white-balance change is a match improvement. On the q13 top band, L went 213.5 -> 204.2 and B-R +4.3 -> +10.1. On the rear wall, L went 205.1 -> 186.7 and B-R +4.1 -> +10.6. The photo measures 219 L / B-R +9.3 on the py_37302 rear wall and 195 L / +10.1 on the bins. The hue now matches. The rear wall is about 30 L darker than the photo wall, and if anything that is a little dim; worth a look by the lighting owner, but not a PY cost. (2) The window glass in q14 changed slightly (x 440-520, y 120-330 in the crop): this is sky/LUT and is lighting-owned. (3) Carried over: the q14 diamond sun patch on the window-seat back is unchanged at about 163 L. The PY fabric is darker than the photos: q14 mid back L 122 against py_37301 back 159, and q13 front back L 114 against py_37302 124. The local fleck contrast is fine (high-pass sd 28.5/23.2 against the photos' 29-30). The gap is exposure and mean level, not texture. (4) L<25 counts: q13 9077 against 8934, q14 9725 against 9719; the change is all in the environment.
